name: starting a project no longer makes you a member
from:
create trigger agenda_project_seed_owner
  after insert on public.agenda_projects
to:
create trigger agenda_project_seed_owner
  after update on public.agenda_projects

name: the owner is seeded with a status the helpers do not accept
any signed-in person can read any project
anybody can create a project owned by somebody else
the repointing skips the existing agenda tables
site records are readable without membership
site records are writable without membership
a confidential document is readable by any member
issuing a new revision does not make it current
from:
set current_revision_id = new.id, updated_at = now()
  where id = new.drawing_id;
to:
set updated_at = now()
  where id = new.drawing_id;

name: a revision replaces the one before it
money is readable by any member
to:
using (public.agenda_is_member(project_id));
      drop policy if exists "agenda money: write"

name: money is writable by any member
from:
with check (public.agenda_is_member(project_id)
                    and (public.agenda_can_view_finance(project_id)
                         or public.agenda_is_owner(project_id)));
      drop policy if exists "agenda money: update"
to:
with check (public.agenda_is_member(project_id));
      drop policy if exists "agenda money: update"

name: contracts are gated on finance rather than on contracts
the contracts permission reads the wrong column
the contracts permission is open to a signed-out visitor
from: revoke all on function public.agenda_can_view_contracts(uuid) from public, anon;
to: revoke all on function public.agenda_can_view_contracts(uuid) from public;

name: a draft change order moves the contract sum
the contract sum is incremented rather than recomputed
the contract's current value stops including changes
retention is folded into the invoice total
from: generated always as (amount + tax_amount - retention_amount) stored;

name: a part payment marks the invoice paid
a payment settles an invoice nobody approved
a BOQ line total is written rather than computed
from:
generated always as (round(quantity * unit_price, 2)) stored;

create index if not exists agenda_boq_project_idx
to:
generated always as (quantity) stored;

create index if not exists agenda_boq_project_idx

name: one counter serves every record kind
anybody can take a number from anybody's project
the counter never advances
the number handed back is the one after the one reserved
the counter table is left open to members
from: alter table public.agenda_counters enable row level security;
to: alter table public.agenda_counters disable row level security;

name: numbering is left open to a signed-out visitor
issuing a submittal revision does not make it current
a submittal revision points at the wrong submittal
a new submittal revision replaces the one before it
from:
set current_revision_id = new.id, updated_at = now()
  where id = new.submittal_id;
to:
set current_revision_id = coalesce(current_revision_id, new.id), updated_at = now()
  where id = new.submittal_id;

name: the site file bucket is public
site files are readable without membership
anybody can file into anybody's project
a progress panorama still needs a file of its own
from:
alter table public.agenda_photos
  alter column storage_path drop not null;
to:
alter table public.agenda_photos
  alter column storage_path set default 'x';

name: a photo row with no image at all is accepted
from: check (storage_path is not null or panorama_job_id is not null);

name: the contracts permission answers yes to everybody
the oldest helpers are left open to a signed-out visitor
from: execute format('revoke all on function public.%s from public, anon', fn);
to: execute format('revoke all on function public.%s from public', fn);
